nusmp.skill.grimoire_crystal.description: Grimoire magic: Crystal Magic. The mage grows and shapes crystal out of the grimoire: bolts, shard volleys and prism beams of refracted light, cages and domes of faceted glass, and a scope that shows every foe for miles. Its pages strike and splinter, blind and pin, dash through light, harden your body into crystal and raise fields of thrusting gems, with a Grand Prism Cannon as the signature and a daily Crystal Resonance that mends friends and shakes foes apart. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_crystal.description: The grimoire of Crystal Magic: twelve pages of faceted crystal. Starters fire a piercing crystal bolt that marks its target and a fan of slowing shards; mid pages cast a blinding Prism Beam that refracts into nearby foes, Shatter Burst, a pinning Crystal Cage, a Prism Step dash, the Crystal Scope that reveals every enemy within 48 blocks, and Crystal Armor; the zone pages raise a Crystal Garden and a projectile-reflecting Prism Dome; the signature is the Grand Prism Cannon; the daily Crystal Resonance heals allies and shakes foes. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_shards: The grimoire sheds a handful of crystal splinters, each one sharp as a cut gem. Fires 5 shards in a fan, 4 damage each, scaled by Existence Points; every hit slows the target for 1.5 seconds and bleeds a little of its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_beam: Light pours through a crystal and comes out as a lance. A beam 26 blocks long hits up to 4 enemies for 9 damage and blinds them for 2.5 seconds, then splits at the first foe it strikes into up to 3 weaker rays that find other enemies within 9 blocks for 5 damage and 1.5 seconds of blindness. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.shatter_burst: The target's skin clouds over with crystal, and then it comes apart. After a short half-second the target takes 12 damage (18 if it is Glowing from the scope or a Crystal Strike) and bleeds magicules, and the splinters hit every other enemy within 4.5 blocks for 6 damage and Weakness for 4 seconds. Barriers and spell projectiles within 3 blocks are broken.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_cage: Tinted crystal rises from the ground and closes over the head of the target. A single target within 18 blocks is held in place with extreme Slowness and Weakness for 3.5 seconds (shorter on bosses), takes 6 damage, and is walled in by a temporary cage of tinted crystal. It shares the hard control cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_step: You become a ray of light bent through a crystal. Dash up to 10 blocks forward, passing through everything on the way: foes along the path take 7 damage, are blinded for 2 seconds and slowed for 1.5 seconds. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_scope: The grimoire builds a helm of crystal with twin telescopes and a speaking tube, so you and your friends see what is far away. For 20 seconds you and allied players within 32 blocks gain Night Vision, every enemy within 48 blocks (up to 16, nearest first) is outlined with Glowing, and the action bar reports the nearest foe's health, condition and distance.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_armor: Facets of crystal grow over your skin and turn the blows back on whoever throws them. For 15 seconds you gain Absorption III and Resistance, your melee hits deal 4 extra damage and attackers are cut by thorns. Extra damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_garden: Gems burst out of the ground like a field of frozen flowers. At the point you aim at (up to 24 blocks), a 5 block radius zone lasts 5 seconds; each second it hits enemies inside for 4 damage, slows them for 2.5 seconds and bleeds their magicules, and raises amethyst clusters on the ground that vanish after 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_dome: A dome of cut crystal closes round you, and light bends instead of landing. For 7 seconds a 6 block dome at your feet reverses every enemy projectile that enters (it becomes yours), blinds enemies inside for 2 seconds every second, and grants you and your allies inside Resistance.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.grand_prism: All the light in the grimoire is gathered into one flawless crystal and released at once. After a 1 second charge a beam 36 blocks long and 3.6 wide deals 26 damage to everything on its line, blinds for 5 seconds, applies Weakness II for 5 seconds, jams magic (Magic Jamming) for 3 seconds and bleeds 3 percent of their magicules, and shatters barriers where it ends. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_resonanc: The grimoire strikes one clear note, and every crystal for ten paces rings with it. Three pulses in 2 seconds in a 10 block radius: enemies take 6 damage per pulse and are slowed, with Weakness II on the last; allies in range are healed by 30 percent of their max health and gain Absorption II and Regeneration II. Usable once every 10 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_strike: A single faceted spear of crystal is flung from the open grimoire and does not stop for the first thing it meets. It flies 22 blocks at speed 1.6, pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage scaled by Existence Points, and leaves each of them Glowing for 5 seconds so the other pages can find them.
